To: Maya Rosen <maya.rosen@convoyhealth.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@convoyhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Convoy Health — contract signed; next steps + warm pass to CS

Hi Maya / Daniel — great to close this week, and excited to have Convoy Health on Redwood. Quick summary and immediate asks so we can hand to CS cleanly: 

- Contract: countersigned and effective 2028-01-09 (SOW attached).
- Initial scope: 3 inference endpoints (chat + embeddings), up to 5M tokens/month; reserved Dedicated pool: G4d.x6, auto-burst policy enabled for first 60 days.
- Data handling: customer-managed VPC peering; logs retained 90 days per the contract.
- Kickoff: proposed week of 1/23, prefer Tue 1/24 10:00 PT for technical kickoff.

Immediate asks from Convoy Health: please confirm preferred kickoff date and the primary technical contact for networking (VPC peering) and identity (SAML).

Internal notes for CS: 
- Primary sales owner: Priyom Das.
- Suggested CS lead: Tessa Morgan (cc'd).
- Key risks: customer requires strict IP allowlist for the peering window; legal requested a non-prod environment for testing prior to production traffic.
- Attachments: SOW v1, Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft.

Maya/Daniel, once you confirm kickoff we will send a calendar invite with the MAP and an ops checklist for peering. Tessa — can you pick this up as the CS steward? I'll handover the MAP and the HubSpot deal (link below).

Thanks,

Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0183

Tech contacts:
- Networking/VPC: Maya Rosen (maya.rosen@convoyhealth.com)
- Identity/SAML: Daniel Park (daniel.park@convoyhealth.com)

1) Can you provision a non-prod sandbox with the same Dedicated config for us to run smoke tests?
2) We'd like a short runbook for sample traffic shaping during the first 48 hours of go-live.

If you can share the MAP updated for our internal teams before the 24th, we'll review and mark owners.

Subject: INTERNAL: Convoy Health warm pass + kickoff prep (please own)

Tessa — assigning handoff to you as discussed. Thread below for context; high-level handoff checklist and asks: 

1) Confirm CS lead and primary engineer (I recommend Tessa as lead, Ben as escalation/throughput owner).
2) Create a one-page kickoff agenda for 1/24 (30–45 mins): introductions, MAP walkthrough, VPC peering steps, SAML/identity checklist, test plan for non-prod, go-live ramp plan (first 48 hours).
3) Provisioning request: please file infra request for a non-prod sandbox that mirrors Dedicated pool (G4d.x6) with token limits set to 10% of prod to simulate load. Mark this as high priority — Convoy requested it pre-kickoff.
4) Deliverables before kickoff: updated MAP with owners, peering runbook, and a short traffic-shaping runbook (1 pager).
5) Stakeholder comms: send consolidated invite to Convoy and include an ops readiness doc + link to the HubSpot deal (https://hubspot.com/deals/4382).

Risk items to track: IP allowlist windows (customer needs us to coordinate firewall windows), SOC2 evidence thread (customer security team will ask for audit artifacts during onboarding). I've attached the SOW and MAP drafts to the HubSpot deal.

Please reply-all to acknowledge ownership and if you want me to loop in Platform Eng for peering specifics.

Cheers,
Priyom

--
